heading.ht: Konnen moun ki vle reprezante w.
heading.en: Meet the people seeking your vote.

intro.ht: Chèche yon non. Chwazi yon eleksyon. Louvri foto yon moun pou eksplore sous enfòmasyon ki konsène li.
intro.en: Search a name. Choose a race. Open a portrait to explore the sources about that person.

search.ht: Chèche yon non, yon pati oswa yon lokalite
search.en: Search a name, party or place

status_note.ht: KEP poko pibliye lis definitif kandida yo. Yon enskripsyon pa vle di KEP valide kandidati a.
status_note.en: The CEP has not yet published the definitive candidate list. Registration does not mean a candidacy has been validated.

snapshot.ht: Done piblik KEP yo te verifye nan dat

no_results.ht: Pa gen rezilta pou filtè sa yo. Eseye yon lòt non oswa efase filtè yo.
no_results.en: No registrations match these filters. Try another name or clear the filters.

load_error.ht: Nou pa rive chaje lis la. Eseye ankò oswa sèvi ak lis pa pòs yo anba a.
load_error.en: We could not load the directory. Retry or use the office lists below.

browse_note.ht: Lis sa yo mache menm san JavaScript.
browse_note.en: These lists work even without JavaScript.

web_hint.ht: Pase sourit la, sèvi ak klavye a oswa peze yon pwen sou twal la.
web_hint.en: Hover, use your keyboard or tap a point on the web.

web_label.ht: Twal sous enfòmasyon sou moun sa a
web_label.en: Web of sources about this person

no_sources.ht: Nou poko ajoute sous revize nan kategori sa a.
no_sources.en: No reviewed sources have been added to this category yet.

coverage.ht: Achiv sa a ap grandi. Li pa gen tout sa ki te janm pibliye sou moun nan. Kantite sous yo montre travay rechèch nou, li pa yon nòt sou moun nan.
coverage.en: This archive is growing. It does not contain everything ever published about this person. Source counts describe our research, not a score for the person.

preview_empty.ht: Chwazi yon fil pou dekouvri sous yo.
preview_empty.en: Choose a strand to discover the sources.

preview_hint.ht: Chak sous gen non piblikatè li, dat li ak yon rezime. Peze Escape pou fèmen apèsi a.
preview_hint.en: Every source includes its publisher, date and a summary. Press Escape to close the preview.

no_autoplay.ht: Videyo a ap chaje sèlman lè ou chwazi gade li.
no_autoplay.en: The video loads only when you choose to watch it.

registry_summary.ht: Non sa a parèt nan done piblik enskripsyon KEP pou eleksyon 2026–2027 yo. Done sa yo preliminè; yo pa konfime KEP valide kandidati a.
registry_summary.en: This name appears in the CEP's public registration data for the 2026–2027 elections. These data are preliminary and do not establish a validated candidacy.

native_record.ht: Enfòmasyon ki nan dosye a parèt anlè paj sa a. Sous: KEP / CEP.
native_record.en: The registration details appear at the top of this page. Source: KEP / CEP.

correction.ht: Siyale yon erè oswa pwopoze yon sous
correction.en: Report an error or suggest a source

independent.ht: Yon pwojè endepandan pou edikasyon sivik

featured_title.ht: Ki moun ki vle reprezante w?

featured_text.ht: Chèche moun ki enskri pou prezidan, senatè, depite ak pòs lokal yo. Louvri pwofil yo pou eksplore sous enfòmasyon sou yo.
featured_text.en: Find registrations for president, senate, deputy and local offices. Open a profile to explore the sources about each person.

copy_failed.ht: Ou ka kopye adrès paj la nan navigatè a.
copy_failed.en: You can copy the page address from your browser.

stale.ht: Done sa yo bezwen yon lòt revizyon. Gade dat ki endike anlè a.
stale.en: These records need another review. Check the snapshot date above.
